cohort: 957 women who underwent C-sections at Lady Willingdon Hospital, Khairpur Mir's Pakistan from June 1, 2021 to December 31, 2021.
finding: High maternal weight and age, preoperative anemia, placenta previa or abruption, antepartum hemorrhage, third trimester bleeding, multiparity, assisted reproductive technology (ART), prophylactic anticoagulation, and prolonged labor were significantly associated with blood transfusion during C-section.
birth_weight: No significant difference in birth weights between neonates born to mothers who received blood transfusions and those who did not.
